commit.message:
feat(app): set the part's X and Y in the work plane by an edge or two points

A setup alignment mode that turns the part about the setup's Z so a
picked straight edge, or two picked points, runs along +Y and/or +X.
The direction is read through the setup's current part alignment (so it
composes after a face-to-plane lay), projected into the setup's XY, and
optionally flipped. With both axes given the primary one (Y by default)
is laid exactly and the other is only checked (not parallel, not
left-handed); with one, the other follows right-handed (X = Y x Z).

- app: pick::axis (turn_in_plane, in_plane_turn_deg) feeding the
  existing undoable AlignPartToSetup (new turn_in_plane / check_turn
  doors): stock and linked setups follow, ops go stale, undo restores.
  Refused by name: a face, a closed or curved edge, one point,
  coincident points, a non-part pick, a direction near the plane
  normal, parallel or left-handed X/Y, nothing picked.
- ui: "Axes in the plane" rows on the setup page - per axis Edge / Two
  points, a pick toggle naming what it takes, Flip; Primary, Apply axes
  (greyed with the command's reason), Clear axes. The draft
  (crate::axis_pick) routes Edge / Vertex clicks; one draft collects at
  a time.
- mcp: set_part_axes, one undo step.
- docs/decisions/557-axis-by-edge.md.

Fixes #557

fix(ui): the setup page's plane alignment picks faces only

Picking a face for "Lay on a plane" kept snapping to an edge. The row
now arms Face mode ("Pick a face"), so a click beside an edge takes the
face. An edge cannot define a plane, so the #330 two-edge plane mode is
removed rather than left half-reachable: pick::lay_on_plane refuses an
edge pick by name ("an edge cannot set a plane; pick a flat face
(edges set an axis: Axes in the plane)"), and an edge or point that
reaches the plane draft is refused by name in the status line with the
face kept. The page says which pick each row takes: a face for the
plane, an edge or two points for an axis (#557). The 3-2-1 and
operation-geometry edge picking are unchanged.

Tests: a real viewport click 4 px inside a face beside its edge takes
the face with the plane row armed and the edge with an axis row armed;
edge picks refused by name (app and draft); the concave step and
winding tests now pin the face; structural setup-page rows.
docs/decisions/554-plane-pick-faces-only.md.

Fixes #554

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(ui): axis picks arm on mode choice, name points in document units, and Flip re-applies

The #573 hand check's three notes:
- Choosing "+Y/+X by Edge" or "by Two points" arms that axis's pick at
  once. With the axes rows on screen and nothing armed, a feature click
  on the part says which Pick toggle to use, never "open an operation
  first".
- The picked row is its own line in document units: "2 points on
  'block' (..) -> (..) mm", or an edge's length and direction - no
  feature id.
- Apply keeps the picks (disarmed), so ticking Flip offers Apply again
  as a 180-degree turn; one AlignPartToSetup undo step per Apply.

Refs #557

fix(ui): setup picks disarm when their page is left

An armed Setups page pick (+Y/+X by Edge or Two points, the lay-on-a-plane
face) stayed armed after its page was left, so edge/vertex/face clicks on
an operation page fed the hidden setup draft. The pick rows now record
their setup each frame they are drawn; after the properties pane,
axis_pick::disarm_hidden stops every pick whose rows were not drawn. The
picks stay: the plane draft gains a picking flag and is paused rather
than dropped, so re-opening the page shows the picks disarmed and
"Pick a face" resumes the draft.

Fixes #664

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CUsqDAgjpiZbXSvmXLvdmL

fix(ui): the setup-pick sweep runs every frame, whatever the dock shows

#664's disarm sweep ran inside pages::properties, so with the Properties
tab closed or hidden behind another tab in its leaf an armed Setups page
pick stayed armed and viewport clicks fed the hidden setup draft. The
shell now brackets the dock with it once a frame: before the dock, a
Properties tab that will not draw disarms every pick (so the viewport,
which routes clicks inside the dock, never sees one); after the dock,
picks whose rows were not drawn are disarmed and axis_rows_shown is
re-earned from the same row marks. The duplicate in pages::properties
is gone.

Fixes #667

test(ui): pin the pre-dock disarm when the viewport draws first

The pane is hidden (the Machines tab brought to the front of the
properties leaf via the View door's layout request) in the same frame
the release of a viewport click arrives. The request settles before the
dock draws and the viewport routes the click inside the dock, before the
after-dock sweep - so only the before-dock disarm keeps a Two points
pick from taking a second point into the hidden draft.

Refs #667
